main_slogan: Building Connections. Delivering Satisfaction. Creating the Future.
sub_slogan: From Demolition to Remodeling & Renovation — Complete Building Solutions Under One Roof.
introduction: At YUIMITSU Co., Ltd., we provide comprehensive building solutions, specializing in restoration work, interior demolition, wooden house demolition, and property clearance. Our expertise also includes reinforced concrete (RC) demolition, steel structure demolition, underground obstruction removal, tree felling and stump removal, industrial waste collection and transportation, remodeling, and renovation. We believe demolition is not simply about tearing down structures—it is about preparing the foundation for new opportunities. Every project is approached with integrity, precision, and a commitment to quality. Our goal is to deliver safe, reliable, and professional services while building long-lasting relationships with our clients and partners.

about_us.heading: ABOUT US
about_us.content: Building Connections. Delivering Satisfaction. Creating the Future. The name YUIMITSU reflects the values that define who we are. "YUI (結)" represents connection, trust, and meaningful relationships. "MITSU (満)" represents fulfillment, satisfaction, and our commitment to delivering outstanding results. These principles guide every project we undertake. At YUIMITSU, we believe every building has the potential for a new beginning. Whether through demolition, restoration, remodeling, or renovation, we help transform properties into spaces that support the future.
